title: Finite intermediate field with single-component inverse images
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $\Omega=k^{\mathrm{sep}}$ be a separable closure [def-kun-separably-closed], and let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Suppose $X_\Omega=X\times_k\Omega$ [def-pc-fibre-product] has finitely many irreducible components [def-weil-irreducible-components]. There is an intermediate field $k\subseteq L\subseteq\Omega$ [def-pc-field-extension], finite-dimensional over $k$, such that for every irreducible component $A\subseteq X_L$, its full inverse image under $X_L\times_L\Omega\to X_L$ is an irreducible component of $X_L\times_L\Omega$. This asserts descent of components to a finite field and does not assert geometric irreducibility under arbitrary field extensions.

proof.text: For each of the finitely many components of X_Ω choose an affine open of X meeting it. The minimal prime defining its restriction is finitely generated because the coordinate ring is finite type over Ω. Collect the finitely many coefficients in all these generators. The intermediate field L generated by them is finite over k, since Ω/k is algebraic.

proof.text: Gal(Ω/L) fixes each defining ideal on its chosen affine open, hence fixes the whole component, which is its closure. Descend the invariant closed subsets along Spec Ω to Spec L. Generalizations lift under the flat projection, so the descended subsets are maximal irreducible subsets of X_L. Every component downstairs is the image of a component upstairs by integrality, flatness and surjectivity. Since each upstairs component is invariant, a downstairs component has one upstairs component as its entire inverse image. Identify X_Ω with the iterated pullback by its projection-compatible tower isomorphism. For empty X take the bottom intermediate field.

theorem exists_finite_intermediateField_component_preimages {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (hfinite : (irreducibleComponents
      ↥(pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (SeparableClosure k)))))).Finite) :
    ∃ L : IntermediateField k (SeparableClosure k),
      Module.Finite k L ∧
      ∀ A ∈ irreducibleComponents
        ↥(pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))),
        (pullback.fst
          (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))))
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom L.subtype))) ⁻¹' A ∈
            irreducibleComponents
              ↥(pullback
                (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))))
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom L.subtype)))
